purpose: Auditable static building category contracts for no-compromise custom construction laws.
validationState: Static/source-authored only. Contracts are joined to exact custom_factions/source_mechanics currentRows; they are not runtime proof that a BuildingData payload reaches a construction hook with the same SID.
rules: Every concrete row mapping must reference an exact source_mechanics id and one of that mechanic's exact currentRows.
Every profile eligible group token must either have at least one concrete row mapping or an explicit missingGroups explanation.
Do not infer categories from donor city identity, display text, icon art, scene object names, or broad faction assumptions.
No building category fact may feed promoted gameplay until construction commit ordering, charged/displayed cost parity, city owner resolution, and packet gameplayAllowed are proven.
